rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when paying or rewarding someone for work.

example.english: We’ll compensate the technician for fixing the air conditioner.
example.traditional: 我哋會畀錢師傅整部冷氣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 bei2 cin2 si1 fu6 zing2 bou6 laang5 hei3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when making up for a shortfall, fault, or disadvantage.

example.english: You were late this time, so please compensate us by treating us to a meal.
example.traditional: 你今次遲到，請我哋食飯補返啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 ci3 ci4 dou3 ceng2 ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6 bou2 faan1 laa1

rows.note: Use this slice of sense 2 when compensating means doing something in place of the original action or person.

example.english: They took today off, so I’ll compensate by attending the meeting in their place.
example.traditional: 佢今日請假，我代替佢開會。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 ceng2 gaa3 ngo5 doi6 tai3 keoi5 hoi1 wui2

rows.note: Use this when adapting what you do to accommodate a problem or changed condition, especially while driving.

example.english: There’s a traffic jam ahead, so we need to compensate by driving more slowly.
example.traditional: 前面塞車，我哋要就住揸慢啲。
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 sak1 ce1 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zau6 zyu6 zaa1 maan6 di1
